name: Five Little Children
competency: Counting down backwards, stepwise subtraction, linking action rhymes with mathematical removal
ncertStandard: Grade 1 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 3 (Five Little Children)
overview: A colorful Choo-Choo Train travels across railway stations. Children wave and disembark one by one to the tune of the NCERT rhyme ('Five little children, raise your hand... Now, we are four!'). Children calculate remaining passengers down to 'none' (0).
learningOutcomes: Recite and apply sequential backwards counting (5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0)
Recognize 'none' as zero in daily life situations (train passengers leaving at stations)

levels.name: Rhyme Express (5 Children)
levels.description: NCERT original 5-verse rhyme with 1 child stepping off per station

levels.name: Tour Express (10 Children)
levels.description: Groups of 2 or 3 passengers stepping off at each station
